4.6•9 reviews•

Visit website

Like Google Photos, but fully local. Turn the terabytes of video, audio, meetings, and files you work with into searchable memories, without uploading anything to the cloud. Clipto automatically tags people, dialogue, and scenes, so you can instantly find any moment buried in your media just by describing what you're looking for. It's fast too: on a MacBook Pro M5, Clipto indexed 2TB of videos in just 24 hours.

## Clipto MCP

Launching today [...] I had a four-minute Chinese video recommending three books for people working in growth and operations. Normally I’d have to scrub through it to find the titles again.

After connecting the library to Codex through MCP, I asked the question in natural language, and Clipto surfaced the source video with timestamped clips for the exact moments where each book was mentioned.

That’s probably the part I like most so far. It turns a folder of media into context an agent can actually use, without uploading files one by one.
